device.mode: Headless desktop, 1280x720, no CPU/mobile emulation; shared host, load/power not controlled

network.conditions: Live HTTPS CDN, no network throttle or interception; host uplink, DNS, TLS, proxy/CDN caches and bandwidth not controlled or characterized

definitions.cold: New browser process and isolated context per pair; empty browser HTTP cache, not a guaranteed cold OS/DNS/CDN cache
definitions.warm: Fresh page and module worker in same primed context; previous page closed; CDN HTTP cache verified from worker Resource Timing, local harness files remain no-store
definitions.ready: Document navigation time origin through module fetch, controller import, worker creation, Pyodide load/version check, evaluator installation, and successful a+ search response; excludes browser launch, includes readiness probe, not production UI paint
definitions.evaluation: One case per request in an already-live worker; browser performance.now around controller.evaluate; repeated-pattern includes first compile then CPython re cache; unique-pattern adds a unique regex comment for each sample to avoid re cache; not isolated compiler timing
definitions.percentiles: Nearest rank ceil(p*n); all raw samples retained; 5 independent cold/warm pairs, 100 serial samples per workload/mode on final warm worker; no discarded outliers
definitions.transfer: Sum worker Resource Timing encodedBodySize for version-pinned runtime resources (compressed response bodies, not TLS/wire/header bytes). transferSize is browser-reported transfer with header-size accounting; cache hits can report zero. Missing/zero body sizes are inconclusive. Excludes local application assets.
